snippet.title: Slime Kingdom: The Tale of the Slime That Became a Hero
snippet.description:
A deckbuilding tabletop rpg narrated by the Slime King.
Take on quests, battle through the land as you explore and collect cards, trinkets and gold.
Build decks that synergise with your skills and face the ultimate enemies!

All in the journey to become the Slime Hero!
